verdict.rationale: Oneleet's Fieldwork page says users describe a control and AI agents then collect, validate, and package evidence on the user's schedule. That is user-configured, autonomous background automation, but the only source is a single marketing claim. Supporting evidence covers built-in daily repository scans and service keys scoped for AI agent automation and scripts, though the latter means you build the automation yourself. missing for 10: technical docs on how to configure, schedule, and monitor Fieldwork agents; user-defined triggers or workflows beyond evidence collection; independent or hands-on corroboration.
